about_the_game:
Inside Light Switcher’s Mind is a first-person surreal puzzle adventure game where you explore the restless dreams of an overworked electrician. After long days fixing switches and circuits, his mind continues the work at night, trapping him in a mysterious dream world. Your goal is to solve light-based puzzles by changing button colors to escape and find peace.

Gameplay & Features:

  • Puzzle Mechanics: Interact with light switches to change colors and unlock new paths.

  • Challenges: Tackle increasingly complex light-based riddles that test your problem-solving skills.

  • Story & Progression: Uncover the electrician’s struggle through a narrative revealed as you progress through puzzles.

  • Genre: A surreal puzzle adventure with a focus on exploration and logic.

  • Unique Elements: Experience a dreamlike atmosphere enhanced by an immersive soundtrack.

Navigate a bizarre dreamscape to end the electrician’s sleepless nights. Ready to flip the switch and break free? Download Inside Light Switcher’s Mind now!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7770 / Intel UHD 620
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560
